title.narrative: Strengthening of Infrastructure and Sustainable Energy Programme in Milne Bay, Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: The project’s main objectives are to develop practical and sustainable solutions to the provision of energy access in Milne Bay, Papua New Guinea, thereby introducing pathways between reliable electricity and development outcomes such as better incomes, health and increased education. Introducing reliable and renewable sources of energy would bring about considerable benefits for the local population, from improved livelihoods and the possibility to develop small businesses, strengthened health and educational services, and improved wellbeing through access to energy for households. UNOPS will support the feasibility study of the Milne-Bay climate resilient infrastructure needs, including land access requirements, and an assessment of the optimal technology mix to minimise the use of diesel fuel generation.
